iatanote: IATA Jet Fuel Price Monitor ve Platts rafineri marjı (crack spread) göstergesi haftalık resmî rapordan alınmaktadır.

providers.iata: IATA / Platts Jet Fuel Price Monitor
providers._doc: EIA is primary when EIA_API_KEY is set; otherwise (or when EIA fails) FRED serves the same EIA series. FRED uses FRED_API_KEY when set, else the keyless fredgraph.csv. ICE Futures Europe provides daily market closes for Brent crude (BZ=F). IATA Jet Fuel Price Monitor provides weekly global jet fuel and crack spread benchmarks.

market._doc: ECB rates are still collected and stored; with display_fx false the API serves no fx_usd_* items or fx events. Values are CURRENCY per 1 USD (USD/EUR 0.889 means 1 USD = 0.889 EUR).
